MediaData Player is committed to protecting user privacy. This policy outlines our practices regarding data handled by the application.

1. Data Privacy: We do not collect, transmit, or store any personal information, browsing history, or media content. All data processed by the app remains strictly on your local device.

2. Local Storage: The app requires access to your device storage solely to save downloaded files and play local media as requested by you.

3. No Tracking: We do not use any third-party tracking or analytics SDKs that monitor your personal activity.

4. Updates: We may update this policy from time to time. Continued use of the app constitutes acceptance of these terms.

Welcome to MediaData Player. By using this application, you agree to comply with the following terms and conditions:

1. Use of Tool: This application is a neutral technical tool intended for playing local media and managing personal files. You are responsible for ensuring you have the legal right to any content you access or download using this tool.

2. User Responsibility: You agree not to use the app for any illegal purposes, including but not limited to the unauthorized downloading of copyrighted material. We do not host or provide any content and are not liable for any misuse of the application.

3. Intellectual Property: All trademarks and copyrights related to the application itself belong to the developer. We respect the intellectual property rights of others and expect users to do the same.

4. Limitation of Liability: The application is provided "as is" without any warranties. We shall not be held liable for any damages arising from the use or inability to use the software.

5. Prohibited Activities: You are prohibited from attempting to decompile, reverse engineer, or bypass any security features of the app.
